build_lightconv_model: build a LightConv encoder-decoder model for machine translation using lightweight or dynamic convolutions
configure_lightconv_architecture: configure a LightConv model architecture with custom kernel sizes, attention heads, and dropout rates
build_lightconv_encoder: build a LightConvEncoder with configurable convolution layers and positional embeddings for source sequences
build_lightconv_decoder: build a LightConvDecoder with incremental state support and encoder-decoder multihead attention
review_lightconv_layer: review the LightConvEncoderLayer or LightConvDecoderLayer sub-blocks with GLU activation and feed-forward networks
